Its ornate design was applied by a craftsman in service to the royal family.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 26 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Halberd}} Royal Halberds are spears that were utilized by the [[Hylian Knight]]s who guarded the [[Throne Room]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. They were ornately designed by craftsmen on behalf of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]]. In the present, they are used by high-tier variants of [[Enemy|Enemies]], particularly in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Tabantha Frontier]]. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Since they are made of metal, Royal Halberds will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They are also unable to burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Royal Halberds belong to the [[Royal Gear]] equipment archetype, a group of [[Weapon]]s designed on behalf of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_024" |Life = 50 |Power = 26 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 80 |BuyingPrice = 320 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Halberd}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Royal Halberd is featured as one of [[Link]]'s [[Weapon]]s in {{AoC}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Royal Halberd Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Royal Halberd File:AoC Royal Halberd Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Royal Halberd ==See Also== {{See Also| * Royal Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Halberds, Royal Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
